summary: auth gate: requireAdmin + middleware + empty admin route group + tests
description:
src/lib/admin.ts exports requireAdmin() — same shape as requireUser() but checks ADMIN_USER_IDS env var.  Always 404 on miss (never 401/403).  middleware.ts gates /admin/* and /api/admin/*: non-admins rewrite to /_admin-404 before any handler runs; admin sessions older than 1h (token iat claim) bounce to /sign-in.  See BRD-admin-ui.md §1.1, §1.2, §1.13.

Files:
  - src/lib/admin.ts  (new)
  - src/middleware.ts  (edit)
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx  (new — placeholder 'ADMIN' until 454b376f)
  - src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx  (new — minimal; 454b376f fleshes out)
  - src/app/_admin-404/page.tsx  (new — re-renders standard Next 404)
  - .env.example  (document ADMIN_USER_IDS)
  - src/__tests__/admin.test.ts  (new)

Done when:
  - requireAdmin() returns 404 Response when: unauthenticated / not in allowlist / env unset.
  - requireAdmin() returns User record when in allowlist (populated like requireUser).
  - Middleware 404s non-admins on /admin/* + /api/admin/* before reaching any handler (handler-side spy verifies).
  - Admin reaching /admin sees placeholder; non-admin sees Next 404 indistinguishable from a bogus path.
  - Admin session > 1h forces re-auth on next admin request.
  - npm run build + tsc --noEmit clean.

Tests (BRD §1.17):
  - requireAdmin → 404 on each failure mode (3 cases).
  - requireAdmin returns User when allowed.
  - Middleware behaviour for /admin/* admin/non-admin/iat-too-old.
  - Middleware does not affect non-admin paths.

Operator action post-merge: set ADMIN_USER_IDS in /etc/guru-web.env, restart guru-web.

analysis.author: 4-R-C-4-N-4
analysis.content: BRD/IMPL spec says rewrite target is /_admin-404. In Next.js App Router, top-level folders prefixed with _ are private/non-routable, so src/app/_admin-404 would never serve. Renamed the path to /admin-404 (no underscore) and updated Caddyfile + middleware to match. Functionally equivalent — purely a Next-convention-vs-spec mismatch.

resolution.note: requireAdmin returns 404 on all non-admin paths. Middleware gates /admin and /api/admin only — non-admins get a /admin-404 rewrite, admin sessions older than 1h get a /sign-in redirect. Non-admin paths untouched. 12 tests pass; tsc + build clean. Renamed BRD's /_admin-404 to /admin-404 (Next disallows _-prefixed top-level folders); analysis note records the deviation.
